note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #21, Q1 2024 Trust in Government) keeps INEGI columns bp4_1_1, bp4_1_2, bp4_1_3 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0324.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's data dictionary labels BP4_1_1 'Confianza en la administracion publica: Presidente de la Republica (Gobierno federal)', BP4_1_2 '...: Gobernador(a) de su estado/Jefe de gobierno [CDMX] (Gobierno estatal)', BP4_1_3 '...: Presidente(a) de su municipio/Alcalde(esa) [CDMX] (Gobierno municipal)'; 3/3 agree with questionnaire 4.1 sub-items 1-3. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 3 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q1 2024 CSV cell for cell -- 33/33 item x level counts (e.g. bp4_1_1 0/5/10 = 2829/2467/6220, bp4_1_2 0/5/10 = 3995/4069/2148, bp4_1_3 0/5/10 = 4505/4214/1784); code 99 (163/592/818) set missing by the .do's Q1-2024-specific rule (0-10 scale, so 9 is valid). Words: section_prompt (4.1 stem) and item_text (sub-items 1-3) are the administered questionnaire wording, fully present in the PDF text layer and checked against a 150 dpi render of p.5; kept as printed incl. trailing '?', '(la)'/'(a)'/'(esa)' fills and '[CDMX]'. Stripped: question/sub-item numbers, dot leaders, the |__|__| entry boxes, interviewer direction 'REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION'. Structure: one section (_1), stem in section_prompt, office-holder in item_text; instructions blank -- Section IV has no read-aloud introduction. Options: the printed scale labels only its endpoints, 00 'Nada' and 10 'Completamente' (identical in catalogos bp4_1_*.csv); resp 1-9 have rows with option_text blank because the questionnaire prints only the bare codes 01-09 and INEGI's catalogo label 'Puntuacion N' is just the number (not shipped, no number padding). 99 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Step 3b: live items match question 4.1 exactly (3 items, resp 0-10); dictionary Description ('Public trust in government institutions to address security concerns') overstates it -- 4.1 asks general trust in three office-holders, with no reference to security; dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while the data and wording are the 2024 Q1 wave (file suffix 0324). NB: this 0-10 format is specific to 2024 Q1; other quarters' bp4_1_* trust items use a 1-4 scale per the .do, so sibling tables must not copy these options. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation); INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, primer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section IV (question 4.1) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, left the unlabelled scale points 1-9 without option text, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
